leadingIndicators.rule: Leading indicators earn comparison points only against same-platform, same-age-bucket history; raw lifetime totals never earn direct profit points.

hardRules: Never expose, commit, or transmit secrets outside their approved destination.
Never claim live, posted, deployed, verified, or complete without authoritative readback.
Never weaken legal, financial, security, privacy, editorial accuracy, release QA, or user-approval gates.
Never optimize vanity metrics at the expense of qualified leads, conversions, gross profit, trust, or platform compliance.
Never create an external side effect outside the authority granted by the user and the active SOP.
